verdict.rationale: Bland's Evals feature uses LLM judges to grade call quality, and the MCP server exposes analytics querying, both of which produce AI-derived assessments from call data inside the product. However, there is no dedicated documentation of proactive AI-generated insights/suggestions (e.g., trend analysis, recommendations) surfaced to users beyond evals and testbed debugging. Missing for 10: an explicit analytics/insights dashboard with AI-generated suggestions, and independent confirmation of this capability in practice.
